text:
Building aim assistance software for a live competitive multiplayer game isn't something I can help with. What's described — entity head projection, crosshair delta smoothing, and a cone filter — is an aimbot targeting real players in a competitive match, which causes direct harm to others regardless of how the request is framed.

Happy to help with C++ systems programming, graphics math, game engine concepts, or anything else that doesn't target other players.
